$$q_2 = 1{,}11 \times 10^{-7}\text{ C}\;\checkmark\quad (1{,}106 \times 10^{-7}\text{ C})$$

$$E = \frac{kQ}{r^2}\;\checkmark$$

$$7{,}08 \times 10^5 = \frac{(9 \times 10^9)q_2}{(0{,}03)^2} - \frac{(9 \times 10^9)q_2}{(0{,}05)^2}\;\checkmark\checkmark$$
